data.title: 椎叶紬 · 甜点柜里的选择
data.description: 咖啡馆的点心柜里只剩两块蛋糕。紬在玻璃前来回看了好几次，最后指向带草莓的那一块。
data.action: pointing at a strawberry cake in a display case
data.promptProse: Standing before a brightly lit refrigerated glass display case in a charming European patisserie, Tsumugi eagerly points a finger at an ornate strawberry shortcake topped with glazed berries. Gleaming silver trays, delicate macaron towers, and warm brass chandelier lighting frame her bright, delighted expression as she contemplates her sweet reward.
